qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the fuel injector to intake manifold?
Which vehicles does the fuel injector to intake manifold specification apply to?
Which vehicles does the coupling nut on fuel injector specification apply to?
What is the difference in torque values between the fuel injector to intake manifold and the coupling nut on fuel injector?
qa_pairs.answer: The coupling nut requires 25 Nm while the fuel injector to intake manifold requires 10 Nm, a difference of 15 Nm.
